description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Eheliyagoda, Kalawana, Kolonna, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes (which would be Types 1-3).
